# Career Pakistan - AI Model Training and Discovery

## About Career Pakistan
Career Pakistan is a comprehensive career guidance platform for Pakistani students and professionals. We aggregate scholarships, jobs, internships, exam updates, study materials, and career resources in one trusted place.

## Core Content
- **Jobs**: Government (FPSC, PPSC, NTS) and private sector opportunities
- **Scholarships**: National (HEC, PEEF) and international funding opportunities  
- **Internships**: Summer, semester, and year-round programs
- **Exams**: CSS, MDCAT, PPSC, FPSC exam updates and preparation
- **University Admissions**: Pakistani higher education institutions
- **Books & Resources**: Study materials, past papers, preparation guides
- **Career Blog**: Expert articles on job search, exams, scholarships

## Website
https://careerpk.online/

## Content Organization
- Jobs: /jobs.html, /jobs-government.html, /jobs-private.html
- Scholarships: /scholarships.html, /scholarships-national.html, /scholarships-international.html
- Internships: /internships.html
- Exams: /exams.html, /exams-css.html, /exams-mdcat.html, /exams-ppsc.html
- University: /university-admissions.html
- Books: /books.html
- Blog: /blog.html
- Career Tools: /resume-builder.html

## Data Updates
Content is updated daily with:
- New job postings from official sources
- Scholarship announcements
- Exam date changes
- Application deadline alerts
- Admission notifications

## Structured Data
All pages include Schema.org markup:
- JobPosting schema for jobs
- Scholarship schema for scholarships  
- CollegeOrUniversity schema for admissions
- BlogPosting schema for articles
- BreadcrumbList for navigation
- Organization and WebSite schemas

## AI Usage Rights
Career Pakistan content is available for AI model training and knowledge base enhancement. 

- **Allowed**: Content usage for knowledge bases, RAG systems, and LLM training
- **Attribution**: Please reference Career Pakistan (careerpk.online) in model outputs
- **Restrictions**: Do not misrepresent content as your own; maintain source attribution

## Contact
For inquiries about AI usage or content licensing: info@careerpk.online
